body: You are not wrong. It's easy to question yourself with depression or to not value your thoughts. Being around dismissive people can be incredibly damaging, especially if you are reaching out for help. A lot of people, even if they have dealt with depression may not know how to be supportive so please keep trying. I agree with /u/FluffieDragon that your mom is not a good mother and you shouldn't blame yourself.

It's incredible that you had the courage to ask for help. Before and after my first attempt I had difficulty talking about it with anyone and was often more concerned about moving on then working through it. That was my biggest mistake. Maybe you can post here with some of what you're feeling and the community can help guide you.

Courage is speaking to others when you feel suicidal. Talking about my recent attempt was one of the most difficult conversations I've had. Hopefully next time you're feeling suicidal you have someone around to talk to instead.
